subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt and refresh https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544, request a current same-repository replacement, or decline the built-in discovery-card behavior?
rationale: The source-level issue remains valid, but an open closing-reference PR already contains the focused fix idea and prevents safe duplicate automated repair until maintainers choose the adoption path.

options.title: Adopt and refresh the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch idea, update it for the current UI path, and require current Control UI proof before merge.

options.title: Request a replacement PR
options.body: Leave the fork PR aside and ask for a same-repository UI-only resolver PR with focused regression coverage and proof.

options.title: Decline discovery cards
options.body: Close this issue and the linked PR only if maintainers decide custom-only snapshots should intentionally hide unconfigured built-in channel cards.

recommendation.title: Adopt and refresh the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch idea, update it for the current UI path, and require current Control UI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history match for the channel UI metadata/catalog path and the adoption-versus-replacement choice.
